title_zh: 澄清视觉测试中的作答对象

scenario.label_zh: 屏幕视觉测试的目标说明
scenario.goal_zh: 区分背景颜色与目标球体并约定先试读修订指令

context_zh: 研究方法课堂中，Owen 与 Sara 为虚构的屏幕观察练习修改给成年参与者的指令。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: The background moves through a spectrum of colors. Should participants respond whenever it changes?

sentences.speaker: Sara
sentences.text: No. The stimulus they should respond to is the blue sphere that appears in the center.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Then “press when the picture changes” is too vague.

sentences.speaker: Sara
sentences.text: Agreed. We should say “press when the blue sphere appears,” and explain that the background is irrelevant.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: I’ll revise the instruction. Could you read it aloud to me before we try it with anyone else?

sentences.speaker: Sara
sentences.text: Yes. Let’s check that the wording points to the sphere, not the changing background.

targets.sense_zh: 一系列颜色构成的范围
